write.title: Write your message
write.description: Choose a creator, write what you want them to say, and set your price. Payment is held in escrow — nothing moves until delivery.

read.title: Creator reads it aloud
read.description: The creator reads your message live to their audience — on stream, in a video, or a personal shoutout. Verified by voice.
read.detail: On stream or in a video

win.title: Everyone wins
win.description: You get your moment heard by their audience. The creator earns {pct}% of what you paid, released automatically the moment they deliver.

items.quote: My daughter's favorite streamer read her name live in front of 20,000 people. She was shaking. I've never seen her that happy. Worth every penny.
items.name: Sarah M.

items.quote: FanVoice changed how I connect with my community. The escrow system means fans actually trust me, and I get fair payment for the time I spend. It's a win-win.
items.name: Alex K.

items.quote: I've tried other platforms and always got burned. FanVoice is the only one where my money is protected. My message went out within a week.
items.name: Omar R.

items.quote: I sent a birthday message to my favorite blogger and she responded with a personal voice note. It felt like talking to a real friend. Absolutely magical.
items.name: Kamola T.

items.quote: Before FanVoice I'd spend hours on DMs that never got answered. Now I know my message will land. Worth every so'm.
items.name: Jasur N.

items.quote: The escrow model is brilliant. My audience doubled after they realized their money is safe. More fans reach out now than ever.
items.name: Nina P.

guarantee.description: We hold your payment in escrow. The creator doesn't receive a single cent until they've read your message aloud. Only after delivery does the payout go through — automatically.

cta.subtitle: Whether you're a fan or a creator, FanVoice was built for you.
cta.fanTitle: Send a message to any creator you love
cta.fanDescription: Find your favorite creator, write what you want them to say, and pay a small fee. If they don't read it — you get every so'm back.
cta.creatorTitle: Turn your voice into income from fans
cta.creatorDescription: Set up your profile, set your price, and let fans send you messages to read. You get paid automatically as soon as you deliver.
cta.finePrint: No setup fee · No monthly charge · Pay only per message
